snippet.title: Deskpot - Idle Farming Game - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST DESKPOT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4590150/Deskpot/

Summary:
A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!
